about: Reason sentences built from FantasyPros' per-player values (preseason or weekly expert ranks, list membership). The published rows store each reason's text only, so a reason is identified by its template: id = the registry feature key (twm.registry), template = its reason_template there. lib/third-party.ts hides them while the site is public (license); tests/test_third_party_reasons.py fails when the registry and this list drift apart.

reasons.template: Was ranked No. {value:.0f} among {pos}s before the season
reasons.example: Was ranked No. 27 among QBs before the season

reasons.template: Was on a preseason ranking list
reasons.example: Was on a preseason ranking list

reasons.template: Was ranked #{value:.0f} at {pos} before the season
reasons.example: Was ranked #9 at K before the season
Experts ranked Jordan Smith #3 at K last week

reasons.template: Was on the experts' weekly {pos} list
reasons.example: Was on the experts' weekly DST list
